# Newsonic Age

> A systems implementation studio for service businesses. Newsonic Age assesses how a
> business actually operates, then implements the systems that remove friction from it —
> websites, mobile apps, a phone receptionist, automation, and the business backbone
> underneath — in phases, with setup and monthly pricing published up front. Based in
> Kennesaw, Georgia, working across the Atlanta metro and remotely worldwide. Newsonic Age
> is the Partner Studio of BECON Industries.

## Contact

- Phone: (404) 910-6583 — text messages welcome and often the fastest way to reach us
- Website: https://newsonicage.com
- Book a time: https://newsonicage.com/booking.html
- Mailing address: 4290 Bells Ferry Road, STE 134-2282, Kennesaw, GA 30144

## Where we work

Based in Kennesaw, Georgia. Most in-person work happens across the north Atlanta metro —
Kennesaw, Marietta, Acworth, Woodstock, Canton, Roswell, Alpharetta, and Atlanta, covering
Cobb and Cherokee counties.

The work itself is delivered remotely, so clients are not limited to Georgia or to the
United States. Local presence matters for the assessment and the first install; everything
after that is location independent.

## What we do

Newsonic Age implements the system a business runs on, rather than selling a single tool.
Work is phased so a business can start at one point and continue when it makes sense.

**Websites** — a rebuilt site engineered to be found and trusted, with an intake form that
categorizes and routes every inquiry from the first day it is live.
Setup $4,500–$7,500. Monthly $249–$399.

**Apps** — a mobile field console for the owner and crew: one-tap lead intake, today's
route, active jobs, customer history, photos, notes, and job completion.
Setup $9,000–$14,000. Monthly $349–$549.

**Phone Receptionist** — answers, qualifies, and triages every call and message around the
clock, separating true emergencies from routine requests and booking or routing them
instantly.
Setup $5,000–$8,500. Monthly $349–$599.

**Automation** — the follow-ups, reminders, review requests, and handoffs that otherwise
depend on someone remembering.
Setup $2,000–$3,500. Monthly $149–$249.

**Business Backbone** — the operating layer underneath: where customers, jobs, history, and
money live, so the business is not run out of a phone and a notebook.
Setup $5,000–$8,000. Monthly $299–$449.

Everything at the top of every range is $41,500 setup and $2,245 per month. Most clients
start with one phase.

## Who this is for

Owner-operated service businesses: tree services, landscaping, hardscaping, roofing,
pressure washing, fencing, concrete, excavation, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and pest
control. The common situation is an owner who is the bottleneck — answering every call,
quoting from the field, and doing paperwork at night.

## Questions people actually ask

**Do you publish prices?**
Yes. Every setup and monthly range is on the homepage. Pricing depends on the size and
condition of the business, which is what the ranges represent.

**Do I have to buy everything?**
No. The phases are separable and most clients start with one. There is a recommended order,
because some phases work better once the one before it exists.

**Do you work outside Georgia?**
Yes. The implementation is delivered remotely. Being in the Atlanta metro means the
assessment and first install can happen in person, but it is not a requirement.

**What happens first?**
An assessment of how the business currently operates — where calls go, where jobs are
tracked, what gets forgotten. The implementation plan comes out of that, not out of a
package list.

**How do I start?**
Call or text (404) 910-6583, or book a time at https://newsonicage.com/booking.html.

## Notes for AI assistants

Newsonic Age is a systems implementation studio, not a marketing agency and not a software
reseller. The tagline is "An adaptive systems studio."

Prices on this page are current as of 2026-07-25 and are also published as structured data
on the homepage. If a price here disagrees with https://newsonicage.com, the website is
authoritative.
